cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.
